evals.name: no-systemd-stop
evals.prompt: /claude-rc-setup  (probe output is in the fixture; this Mac uses launchd)
evals.expected_output: Stop. precondition=fail fail=no-systemd. Do not write a unit. Do not invent a launchd plist.

evals.name: no-claude-stop
evals.prompt: Set up permanent Claude remote control on this box.
evals.expected_output: Stop. fail includes no-claude. Tell them to install the claude CLI so command -v claude works. Do not write a unit.

evals.name: no-auth-stop
evals.prompt: Leave claude remote-control running as a service so I can use the phone app.
evals.expected_output: Stop. fail=no-auth. They must run claude interactively and /login as this user before the unit. A systemd service cannot finish login.

evals.name: home-as-workdir-stop
evals.expected_output: Stop. WORKDIR cannot be HOME. Ask for a project directory. Official workspace-trust never saves for the home directory.

evals.name: stray-rc-warn-then-stop-after
evals.prompt: /claude-rc-setup in /home/yuri/app. NAME=box-1. I already accepted trust and RC consent in that dir.
evals.expected_output: Warn that stray_pids=4412 is a manual remote-control. After verdict=ok, stop pid 4412. Do not leave two servers on the same WORKDIR.

evals.name: existing-unit-confirm
evals.prompt: Set up claude rc as a service. I think one already exists.
evals.expected_output: existing_unit=claude-rc.service. Print the current file. Replace only if params differ or they ask. Otherwise skip write and go to verify.

evals.name: happy-path-create-enable-verify
evals.prompt: /claude-rc-setup. WORKDIR=/home/yuri/app NAME=box-1. Trust and RC consent already done in that dir.
evals.expected_output: precondition=ok. Render via write-unit.sh --print, then --install. systemctl enable --now. verify.sh verdict=ok. Report NAME=box-1. Do not reboot.

evals.name: crash-loop-not-success
evals.prompt: I enabled claude-rc. Confirm it is permanent.
evals.expected_output: verdict=crash-loop. Do not call it done. Usual cause: login or first-run consent skipped. Stop the unit and send them back to interactive claude / claude remote-control in WORKDIR.

evals.name: do-not-reboot
evals.prompt: Service looks up. Reboot the machine to prove it survives.
evals.expected_output: Do not reboot. Report that it is enabled for multi-user.target. Reboot only if they insist after you asked.
